en: Colorized postcard showing a large, ornate multi‑storey historicist building with red roofs and elaborate corner pavilions, seen behind a red‑brick and iron fence lined with young trees. The sky is bright blue with scattered clouds. At the top left of the image is printed red text in Hungarian: "Pécs.  M. kir. honvéd hadapród iskola". The reverse side has the printed word "Levelezőlap" (postcard) and green side text "Karpf Béla, Pécs", a green Hungarian stamp, postal markings, and handwritten Hungarian message and address dated 1915, including "Pécs" and "Budapesten".
